judged_text: The loading view blindly reloads every 30 seconds with no terminal state and no error signal from the retrieve path (which fails silently by design: user missing, host invalid, fetch error, non-URL all produce no topic). When import fails for any reason, the third-party article page shows 'Loading Discussion...' reloading forever, burning bandwidth on both the embedding site and the forum with no diagnostics distinguishing 'in progress' from 'permanently broken'.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces an infinite reload loop in the embed iframe when no topic is ever created. `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` unconditionally reloads every 30s. In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it always renders `loading` and enqueues `:retrieve_topic`. If retrieval never produces a `TopicEmbed` (e.g., `TopicRetriever#retrieve` returns early on invalid host or malformed URL; `fetch_http` returns if `embed_by_username` user is missing; RSS polling may not create the specific URL), the controller will keep returning `loading` forever with no alternate state or error view, causing repeated requests/bandwidth usage.
